data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 114.483m. Using the published gross claims development triangle, cumulative estimates for underwriting years 2011-2013 moved favourably during 2015, producing an aggregate prior-year release of approximately GBP 7.745m (about 6.8% of opening gross reserves). No explicit single-line note stating a gross prior-year movement was found; the figure is derived from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The measurement of the provision for claims outstanding involves judgments and assumptions about the future that have the most significant effect on the amounts recognised in the financial statements.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
During 2015 the Syndicate experienced a relatively low frequency of insured catastrophe or major losses, but of these the loss from the explosion at Tianjin in August 2015 was most significant.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit note stating a gross movement in prior years (Insurance liabilities column) was found. The prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development table (Analysis of claims development - Gross) on page 37 by comparing the latest estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2013 and summing the changes. The triangle included an aggregate '2010 and prior' amount which was excluded per instructions. exact_reserve_text is empty because no single-sentence gross prior-year movement description was located. Amounts reported use the report's presentational currency (GBP) and were converted to millions. Confidence is lower for the prior-year movement because it is derived from the triangle rather than an explicit gross movement note.
